scripts.dev:electron: tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && concurrently -k "npm run dev" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && electron ."
scripts.build:assistant:win: npm run build:assistant && electron-builder --win dir --publish never --config electron-builder.assistant.json --config.directories.output="../.build-IDEA-Assistant" && node scripts/promote-win-build.mjs "../IDEA Assistant" "../.build-IDEA-Assistant"
scripts.build:owner:win: npm run build:owner && electron-builder --win dir --publish never --config electron-builder.owner.json --config.directories.output="../.build-IDEA-Assistant-SRH" && node scripts/promote-win-build.mjs "../IDEA Assistant SRH" "../.build-IDEA-Assistant-SRH"
scripts.package:assistant:win: npm run build:assistant:win && electron-builder --win nsis --prepackaged "../IDEA Assistant" --publish never --config electron-builder.assistant.json
scripts.package:assistant:linux: npm run build:assistant && electron-builder --linux dir --publish never --config electron-builder.assistant.json
scripts.package:owner:win: npm run build:owner:win && electron-builder --win nsis --prepackaged "../IDEA Assistant SRH" --publish never --config electron-builder.owner.json
scripts.package:owner:linux: npm run build:owner && electron-builder --linux dir --publish never --config electron-builder.owner.json
